query:
INSERT INTO schematic (function, width, orientation, encoding,
            latency, synchronized, size_x, size_y, size_z, built_on,
            imported_by, conventional, design, carry_in, carry_out,
            description, uploaded_by, sha256, data)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         RETURNING id as "id!"
